title: A variant space too large to sample fails execute before any variant runs, and withholds the contract.
why: behavioural spec 'execute': 'variant-budget-exceeded' is thrown before any variant runs, from 'variants'. The SDK does not compute a variant space, a sample of one, or a fallback when the engine declines to (SDK spec §2.1's first failure) — it carries the engine's refusal across, and no closure runs.
